# Stova Media | Custom Software Development Agency & AI Agent Studio

> Stova Media is a premier custom software engineering studio and AI agent agency based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. We architect, design, and ship high-fidelity web applications, autonomous AI agent systems, healthcare SaaS solutions, and e-commerce platforms for serious businesses worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Packages

### 1. Growth Website Package
100% Custom Next.js 15 & React code (zero WordPress templates), Google Maps (GMB) #1 ranking optimization, sub-50ms TTFB & 100/100 Core Web Vitals speed guarantee, direct 1-click WhatsApp integration.
- **Delivery**: 10–14 Days
- **Pricing**: Fixed-Scope Milestone Quote

### 2. E-Commerce & AI Agent Storefront
Custom-coded fast checkout store with secure UPI/Card/COD payments, 24/7 intelligent AI WhatsApp & website chatbot, automated inventory & order tracking notifications.
- **Delivery**: 2–3 Weeks
- **Pricing**: Custom Storefront Milestone Quote

### 3. Custom SaaS & Enterprise Architecture
End-to-end custom Next.js 15, TypeScript & PostgreSQL architecture, bank-grade Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), autonomous AI pipelines, private RAG knowledge base & CRM sync.
- **Delivery**: 3–6 Weeks Sprints
- **Pricing**: Bespoke Architecture Milestone Quote

## Verified Portfolio & Case Studies

1. **Mr Compounder** (Healthcare SaaS)
   - *Overview*: Silent OPD token & queue management platform for Indian clinics. No patient app install required; operates seamlessly on 2G.
   - *URL*: https://www.mrcompounder.com
   - *Impact*: 50+ active clinics, 100% availability, zero barrier queueing.

2. **Hair Transplant Simulation / HairViz** (AI & 2D/3D MedTech Platform)
   - *Overview*: AI-driven photo-to-3D hair transplant visualization platform for cosmetic surgeons. Generates scalp models, designs hairlines, calculates graft counts, and animates Month 1-18 growth timelines.
   - *Impact*: Interactive hairline design tool, white-labeled for international clinics.

3. **Dr. Paul's Online Care** (E-Commerce Platform)
   - *Overview*: Doctor-recommended clinical hair & skin care e-commerce platform for Dr. Paul's Multispeciality Clinic (17+ clinics across India & Bangladesh).
   - *URL*: https://care.drpaulsonline.com
   - *Impact*: 1.5s page load speed, multi-clinic fulfillment integration, doctor-curated recovery kits.

4. **Bondhu Motor & Electronic** (Local Business & Web Platform)
   - *Overview*: High-conversion digital presence paired with local GMB dominance for an electric vehicle showroom.
   - *URL*: https://bondhumotorandelectronic.netlify.app/
